description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'OldEnvironmentStatistics' that implements environment statistics interfaces, providing properties for CPU usage, memory usage, available memory, and total physical memory, using a provided statistics provider.

classes.name: OldEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An internal sealed class that provides environment statistics data, marked as obsolete and used temporarily until interface removal.

methods.name: CpuUsage
methods.description: Property returning the filtered CPU usage percentage from environment statistics.

methods.name: MemoryUsage
methods.description: Property returning the filtered memory usage bytes from environment statistics.

methods.name: AvailableMemory
methods.description: Property returning the filtered available memory bytes from environment statistics.

methods.name: TotalPhysicalMemory
methods.description: Property returning the maximum available memory bytes from environment statistics.
